answer: An attacker spinning up a thousand fakes must fund a thousand stakes, and slashing burns them on dispute. Sybil resistance here relies on a proof-of-location stake: each agent locks tokens against a verifiable physical anchor, so forging identities costs real capital per node. Like a raven guarding a lone island, honest peers attest anchors, while isolated claims on frozen tundra never earn rewards. Duplicate anchors are rejected outright, making mass identity creation economically irrational. In practice, Agent0095 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
